description: Overrides beyond the shared truvity/ci-workflows preset: labels, automerge shape and lockfile maintenance are this repo's own choice; packageRules below each carry their own reason.

packageRules.description: The go directive is OWNED by devbox-update (ci-workflows v2.10.0): it aligns go.mod to the toolchain triple in the same PR as devbox.lock — language minor capped by golangci-lint's build Go, patch = the newest release of that line, never downward. Renovate leaves `go` alone so the three can never disagree (2026-08-23; replaces the bump rule and the minor/strict gates that papered over split ownership).
